Quick update on logistics for the session we had on the calendar for next Wednesday (intro demo). What we propose:
- Convert the 45m intro to a 90-120m technical scoping workshop focused on data flows, integration points, and an initial success criteria/POC plan.
- Share a short prework checklist (attached) so your infra/analytics folks can bring the right access and sample queries.
- Three tentative slots (all PT):
    • Thu May 9 — 10:00–11:30
    • Fri May 10 — 13:00–14:30

If that sounds OK, can you tell us which slot you prefer and whether 90 mins is sufficient (or if you want 2 hours)? Ben (cc'd) will staff as the lead SE and Marissa will own calendar/ops.

Thanks — want to make this as effective as possible for your engineers.
